content.title: What exactly am I going to learn?
content.content: You’ll learn to master emotional overwhelm and build calm confidence in 90 days using the EKT method and other practical tools to sense, regulate, and own your emotions. No fluff—just real skills to handle triggers and negative feelings with confidence.

content.title: Do I need prior experience in emotional work or coaching?
content.content: No, but you should be committed to giving your best during the coaching period to achieve the best results for yourself. This includes discipline, courage for self-exploration and dedication.

content.title: I often feel overwhelmed by my emotions — does that mean this workshop might be too hard and intense for me?
content.content: Quite the opposite. If emotional overwhelm is one of your main challenges, this workshop will provide you with clear steps and a safe space to work through it. You’ll learn how to handle your strong emotions effectively.

content.title: How is your approach different from traditional therapy?
content.content: My coaching does not replace therapy. It integrates aspects of traditional cognitive-behavioral therapy and mindset work with emotional intelligence techniques, psychosomatic methods and inner child work. However, since I'm trauma- informed and am part of a network of therapists, I am able to let you know if a professional would be helpful to reach your mental or emotional health goals.
